_about: Hand-kept classifications that override the automatic label. 'label' is shown in the app; 'note' is the one-line explanation. Classes: migrant-summer, winter-influx, spring-summer, heard-winter, heard-spring, resident.

eastern-koel.label: migrant-summer
eastern-koel.note: Arrives from the north around September, breeds over summer and leaves by about March.

channel-billed-cuckoo.label: migrant-summer
channel-billed-cuckoo.note: Arrives August to October, gone again by about March.

golden-whistler.label: winter-influx
golden-whistler.note: Many move down from the ranges in autumn and winter, so Sydney gardens see more of them then.

spotted-pardalote.label: winter-influx
spotted-pardalote.note: Moves down from higher ground in the cooler months.

silvereye.label: winter-influx
silvereye.note: Tasmanian birds cross Bass Strait to winter in NSW, forming large flocks.

yellow-tailed-black-cockatoo.label: winter-influx
yellow-tailed-black-cockatoo.note: Flocks move to the coast in autumn and winter.

grey-fantail.label: winter-influx
grey-fantail.note: Birds pass through and arrive from the south in autumn.

red-wattlebird.label: winter-influx
red-wattlebird.note: Follows banksia and eucalypt flowering; winter flocks.

eastern-spinebill.label: winter-influx
eastern-spinebill.note: More in gardens in autumn and winter as birds leave higher country.

new-holland-honeyeater.label: winter-influx
new-holland-honeyeater.note: More obvious in winter when banksias flower.

pied-currawong.label: winter-influx
pied-currawong.note: Some move down from the ranges to the lowlands in winter.

black-faced-cuckooshrike.label: spring-summer
black-faced-cuckooshrike.note: Here all year but noticeably commoner in spring and summer.

superb-lyrebird.label: heard-winter
superb-lyrebird.note: Resident; the male sings and displays most in winter.

white-bellied-sea-eagle.label: heard-winter
white-bellied-sea-eagle.note: Resident pairs; most vocal and visible around winter breeding.

eastern-whipbird.label: heard-spring
eastern-whipbird.note: Resident; the whip-crack duet is most frequent in spring.

tawny-frogmouth.label: resident
tawny-frogmouth.note: Resident; more reports in spring and summer when fledglings sit out in the open.

welcome-swallow.label: resident
welcome-swallow.note: Migratory further south, but present in Sydney all year.

silver-gull.label: resident
silver-gull.note: Resident; the spring spike in records is a dataset artefact.

australian-brushturkey.label: resident
australian-brushturkey.note: Resident; mound-building in spring and summer.
